**Test image observations:**
- Mango leaf, mostly green
- Significant brown necrotic area at the leaf tip/margin
- Scattered small brown spots across the leaf surface
- No white powder, no black coating, no galls, no curling/crumpling

**Reasoning:**
- The brown necrosis concentrated at the leaf tip/margin with scattered brown spots matches **Anthracnose** — "semicircular lesions on margins of young leaves" and "leaf spots ranging from light tan to deep brown with darker edging near leaf margins"
- Sooty Mould (reference viewed) shows dark black superficial coating across the whole leaf — not present here
- Bacterial Canker would show raised angular spots with greasy margins and chlorotic halos — not visible
- Die Back, Cutting Weevil, Gall Midge, Powdery Mildew all have very different presentations
